spanish: Y varón que yaciere con mujer de su padre, desnudez de su padre descubrió; de morir morirán ambos; sus sangres en ellos.

findings.issue: יומתו is hophal imperfect 3mp (be put to death); morirán is active (they will die), so the passive stem force is changed.

notes: Remaining tokens match, including plural sangres and the verbless final clause.
